 LAURA YEATER
 Cancer Support Community at Gilda's Club will offer a free workshop on Medicare Part D and open enrollment. The Medicare Part D open enrollment runs from October 15 through December 7. Everyone on Medicare should take time to review their plan and make sure that their drugs are still covered and compare plans to identify potential cost savings. Join them to learn the basics of Medicare, and understand coverage options, and discover ways to save money on prescription medications.
